DROP TABLE housing_affordability;

CREATE TABLE athlete_salaries AS SELECT a.athlete_id, a.name, t.team, s.base_salary, s.bonus FROM athlete_data a JOIN team_roster tr ON a.athlete_id = tr.athlete_id JOIN athlete_salary_info s ON a.athlete_id = s.athlete_id JOIN team_data t ON tr.team_id = t.team_id;
CREATE VIEW top_ethical_companies AS SELECT company_name, ethical_certification FROM ethical_manufacturing ORDER BY ethical_certification DESC LIMIT 5;
CREATE TABLE infection_rates (id INT PRIMARY KEY, state VARCHAR(50), infection_rate FLOAT);

CREATE VIEW health_trends AS SELECT metric_name, MAX(metric_value) AS latest_value, (SELECT metric_value FROM ocean_health_metrics ohm2 WHERE ohm2.metric_name = ohm.metric_name AND ohm2.measurement_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) AS one_year_ago_value FROM ocean_health_metrics ohm WHERE measurement_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY metric_name;
CREATE TABLE consumer_demographics (consumer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, age INT, gender TEXT, location TEXT);
CREATE TABLE space_debris (id INT PRIMARY KEY, debris_name VARCHAR(255), launch_date DATE, location VARCHAR(255), type VARCHAR(255));
CREATE VIEW employee_count_by_dept_ethnicity AS SELECT department, ethnicity, COUNT(*) as total FROM employee_demographics GROUP BY department, ethnicity;
CREATE TABLE green_buildings (address VARCHAR(255), size INT, certification VARCHAR(50), city VARCHAR(100));
ALTER TABLE veteran_employment DROP COLUMN salary;
DROP TABLE ai_ethics;
CREATE TABLE cruelty_free_certification (certification_id INT PRIMARY KEY, product_id INT, certification_date DATE, certification_authority TEXT);
CREATE TABLE VolunteerHours (VolunteerHoursID INT, VolunteerID INT, EventID INT, Hours DECIMAL(3,1), HourDate DATE);
CREATE VIEW total_revenue_by_team_country AS SELECT s.team_name, t.country, SUM(t.price) FROM ticket_sales t INNER JOIN sports_teams s ON t.team_id = s.team_id GROUP BY s.team_name, t.country;
DROP VIEW top_students;
CREATE TABLE vendor_locations AS SELECT 1 AS vendor_id, 'Headquarters' AS location_name, 'United States' AS country;
DROP TABLE rural_farmers;
CREATE VIEW top_recycling_regions AS SELECT * FROM waste_generation_metrics WHERE recycled_waste/(total_waste_generated-landfilled_waste) > 0.5;
CREATE TABLE vessel_movement (vessel_id INT, timestamp TIMESTAMP, location VARCHAR(255));
DROP TABLE redundant_billing_data;
CREATE TABLE medical_facilities (facility_id INT, facility_name VARCHAR(255), facility_type VARCHAR(255), location VARCHAR(255), capacity INT);
CREATE TABLE Archaeological_Tools (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), type TEXT, age INT);
CREATE TABLE attorneys (attorney_id INT PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR(50), last_name VARCHAR(50), practice_area VARCHAR(50), years_experience INT);
ALTER TABLE InclusiveHousing ADD COLUMN date DATE;
CREATE TABLE stops( stop_id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), latitude DECIMAL(9,6), longitude DECIMAL(9,6), wheelchair_accessible BOOLEAN);
CREATE VIEW defense_contract_summary AS SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_contracts, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM defense_contracts;
CREATE TABLE ingredient_certifications (certification_id INT PRIMARY KEY, ingredient_id INT, certification_date DATE, certified_by TEXT);
